title: Result
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:42 AM
2. Enter a meter reading unit and choose |*Street Route » Maintain

1 Note

If you want to specify a shared street route for several meter reading units, enter the main meter reading unit.

The Maintain street route dialog box appears. On this screen, all devices are initially found under the top node Devices not

allocated to a street route .

1. Allocate all devices from the top node to the bottom node Devices allocated to the street route.
1. To change the sequence or allocate devices to a route, proceed as follows:

1. Select either an object, a node or a block.

2. Position your cursor on the item selected.

3. Choose |/*Edit > Reassign.

1. Save the street route.

Result
The street route is used to either:

e Sort devices on printouts when you print meter reading orders for the meter reader.

e Sort devices in the file created when you download meter reading orders.

1 Note

You can use the enhancement EDMLSORT (IS-U: Sort Meter Reading Orders for Printing and Downloading) for the street route
to define your own sorting method.

Planning Meter Readers

Usage

You use this function after creating an order to allocate selected meter readers to individual or multiple meter reading orders or to

change existing allocations.

This function provides greater flexibility in unexpected situations (such as illness) as meter readers can now be allocated

temporarily to meter reading orders.

Prerequisites

To use this function, you must first select the Plan Meter Reader indicator in Customizing for SAP Utilities under |sDevice
Management } Meter Reading Meter Reading Order + Order Creation } Define Meter Reader
